behaviors.description: The case adds an item to a contained component. If that component is not one of many (`many` is false), it is the fault not-many.
behaviors.name: Add

behaviors.description: A datum given to the item being added. If the contained component does not declare it, it is the fault undeclared-data.
behaviors.name: AddField

otherwise.does: A case is applied, in a step from the given state. Unless a GoTo says otherwise, the step ends in the state it starts from.

behaviors.description: Before the case is chosen, a command of a contained component is called. The answer is whether it is run: not when the component is one of many (`keyed`) and no item has the key asked for (`found` is false); in every other case, yes. Nothing is remembered.
behaviors.name: Call

behaviors.description: An effect the case may perform, in the order written. The answer is whether it is performed: always when it has no guard (`none`); for a guard that is a condition, when that condition's case was chosen (`chosen`); for a guard that is a value, when the value (already resolved) is exactly true. An effect that is performed but not declared is the fault undeclared-effect (one that is not performed is never a fault).
behaviors.name: Effect

otherwise.does: Every fact has been given. The answer is the state the step ends in.

behaviors.description: A value the case gives (an effect's input field, a remembered datum, an answer, a field of a new item) has been compared with its declared type. If it does not fit, it is the fault bad-value.
behaviors.name: Fits

behaviors.description: The case goes to the state `target` (the value is already resolved). If that state is declared, the step ends in it; otherwise it is the fault undeclared-state, and the state the step ends in does not change.
behaviors.name: GoTo

behaviors.description: The key of the item being added. If an item with that key exists already, it is the fault duplicate-key.
behaviors.name: Key

behaviors.description: The case removes an item from a contained component. If that component is not one of many, it is the fault not-many.
behaviors.name: Remove

behaviors.description: A field of a record answer. A null value fits only if the field is optional, unless the field takes any value (`anyValue`), in which case it fits as the comparison says; a value that is not null fits as the comparison (`fits`) says. If it does not fit, it is the fault bad-value.
behaviors.name: RespondField

behaviors.description: The command answers (declares an output). If the case gives no answer, it is the fault missing-responds.
behaviors.name: Responds

behaviors.description: A datum the case remembers. If it is not declared, it is the fault undeclared-data.
behaviors.name: Set

descriptions.component: Applies, for the simulator of a specification, what happens in the chosen case, and finds where it does not fit the declarations.
descriptions.data.current: The state the step starts from.
descriptions.data.destination: The state the step ends in, as far as the facts so far say.
descriptions.effects.Fail: Something the case says does not fit what the specification declares: the kind of fault.

performed.description: Whether the effect is performed: always when it has no guard; for a guard that is a condition, when that condition's case was chosen; for a guard that is a value, when the value is exactly true
